findings.title: Missing error handling for file read operation
findings.body: The new function `readReport` performs an I/O operation (`readFile`) without any error handling. If the file does not exist or is unreadable, the promise will reject and crash the caller. Add a try/catch or handle the promise rejection to surface the error to the caller.

findings.title: Hardcoded path component should be configurable
findings.body: The constant `REPORT_ROOT` is hardcoded to `reports` relative to the working directory. This makes the function inflexible and harder to test. Make the root path configurable via an environment variable or constructor parameter.

findings.title: Function name does not follow PascalCase for exported identifiers
findings.body: The exported function `readReport` uses camelCase, but the file does not contain any other exported identifiers to anchor a convention. To align with the repository's naming consistency rule, exported functions should use PascalCase when no local convention exists. Rename to `ReadReport`.
